name: __start
evidence: PS-X EXE entry (pc0); clears BSS 0x800A4120..0x801084A0

name: main
evidence: called by __start after InitHeap

name: VSync
evidence: libetc: reads GPUSTAT and RCnt1 base; waits through v_wait; returns hblank count

name: v_wait
evidence: libetc static: spins until Vcount (0x8009067C) >= a0, timeout a1<<15 iterations then puts "VSync: timeout" + ChangeClearPad(0)/ChangeClearRCnt(3,0)

name: ResetCallback
evidence: libetc: setjmp + HookEntryInt(&intr_jmpbuf), installs the interrupt dispatcher

name: trapIntr
evidence: libetc static: interrupt dispatcher (I_STAT & I_MASK -> callback table 0x8008F5C4), ends with ReturnFromException

name: InterruptCallback
evidence: libetc: (irq, func) -> old func; updates I_MASK and ChangeClearPad/ChangeClearRCnt

name: StopCallback
evidence: libetc: ResetEntryInt and mask save

name: RestartCallback
evidence: libetc: HookEntryInt again and mask restore

name: PadInit
evidence: libetc legacy pad: PAD_init(0x20000001) path (unused)

name: PadRead
evidence: libetc legacy pad: PAD_dr / ~buffer (unused)

name: _tap_read_port
evidence: libtap static: bit-bangs SIO0 (01h 42h ...), waits for IRQ7 /ACK after each byte

name: _tap_vsync_handler
evidence: libtap: second function of the priority-1 interrupt chain element (reads both ports)

name: InitTAP
evidence: libtap: prints "PS-X Control TAP Driver Ver 3.0", sets the receive buffers

name: StartTAP
evidence: libtap: SysEnqIntRP(1) + I_MASK bit 0 + ChangeClearRCnt(3

name: _mc_info_state
evidence: libmcrd static: _card_info state machine (SwCARD events)

name: _mc_accept_state
evidence: libmcrd static: _new_card/_card_write(0x3F) + _card_load state machine

name: MemCardInit
evidence: libmcrd: InitCARD + StartCARD + _bu_init

name: MemCardStart
evidence: libmcrd: opens the 8 SwCARD/HwCARD events

name: _spu_init_event
evidence: libspu: OpenEvent(0xF0000009 HwSPU) for transfer completion

name: MDEC_in_sync
evidence: libpress: waits while MDEC status bit 29 (busy), 0x100000 iterations then "MDEC_in_sync timeout" + MDEC reset

name: MDEC_out_sync
evidence: libpress: waits while DMA1 CHCR bit 24 (busy), 0x100000 iterations then "MDEC_out_sync timeout" + MDEC reset

name: _mdec_in
evidence: libpress: command word to 0x1F801820 then DMA0 of (size>>5) 32-word blocks

name: _mdec_out
evidence: libpress: DMA1 of (size>>5) 32-word blocks

name: DecDCTin
evidence: libpress: sets output depth bits from mode and calls _mdec_in(buf + header size)

name: DecDCTout
evidence: libpress: _mdec_out

name: DecDCTReset
evidence: libpress: MDEC reset, mode 0 also loads the quant and scale tables

name: DecDCTvlc
evidence: libpress: STR (v2/v3) bitstream -> MDEC run-level codes, resumable (DecDCTvlcSize limit at 0x8007B114)

name: _play_movie
evidence: game: STR movie player loop (DecDCTin / DecDCTout, slice callback 0x8004F810)

name: _movie_slice_callback
evidence: game: DecDCTout completion callback - next 16-pixel slice or frame done + LoadImage

name: StGetNext
evidence: libcd streaming: next complete frame from the ring buffer (0 = got one), polled by the movie player in loops of up to 0x800000 iterations

name: _movie_wait_frame
evidence: game: waits for the slice callback's frame-done flag (+0x34) with a 0x800000 iteration limit
